title: Launch Surface Trim: Narrow initial dashboard and defer trace-heavy cards
creator: Aisha Thompson
description: Context: To meet the Q1 launch commitment and reduce engineering risk and telemetry cost, we are narrowing the Console initial surface. This ticket documents the set of features to drop from the alpha/GA path and the compensating acceptance criteria. Goal: ship a compact, performant first release of Console insights that exposes cost breakdown, top routes, and simple latency buckets while deferring expensive trace-level visualizations and per-token heatmaps to subsequent milestones.
decisions: Keep three dashboard cards in initial launch: Route Cost Overview, Model Latency Summary (bucketed), and Tokenized Usage Snapshot.
Remove detailed distributed tracing card (flamegraph, span flows) from GA; provide a link to the tracing product guide instead.
Replace per-route cost heatmap with a single top-10 routes list and a consolidated cost delta banner to reduce storage and query complexity.
Disable drilldown-to-span in initial release; enable a read-only link to raw traces for customers with Dedicated or Private deployments.
Sampling: default telemetry sampling rate for Console insights reduced to 2% for initial launch, with explicit opt-in for higher fidelity in later releases (product opt-in flow TBD).
tradeoffs: Pro: Reduces query load and storage costs for telemetry by ~60% for launch workload estimates.
Con: Operators lose immediate per-request trace visualization which impacts debugging speed for early customers; mitigated by linking to existing tracing tooling and SRE-runbooks.
Pro: Shorter implementation window and fewer cross-team dependencies (less infra + less schema change).
Con: Some enterprise customers may request full fidelity; we will backlog a dedicated high-fidelity telemetry plan tied to Dedicated/Private releases.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Dashboard deck exposes exactly three cards: Route Cost Overview, Model Latency Summary (3 buckets: <50ms, 50-200ms, >200ms), Tokenized Usage Snapshot. No additional cards enabled.

AC-2: Route Cost Overview shows top-10 routes by spend for the selected time window and a single percentage delta compared to baseline period; query latency <1s for 95% of requests in staging at 1M events/day simulated traffic.
AC-3: Model Latency Summary aggregates latencies into the three buckets and surfaces 95th percentile per-model; display refresh <2s for typical dashboard interactions.
AC-4: Tokenized Usage Snapshot shows total tokens, embedding units, and a simple per-route token distribution bar chart (no per-token heatmap).

AC-5: The tracing-heavy card (flamegraphs/span flows) is removed from the initial UI and replaced by a contextual help link to tracing docs and an explicit note: 'Detailed traces available via Dedicated & Private integrations'.

AC-6: Telemetry storage and query cost projection for initial config is reviewed and signed off by Infra Finance with estimated monthly cost delta within budget threshold (documented in linked cost model).
AC-7: UX: Design sign-off on condensed visual language and accessible microcopy for deferred features.
AC-8: Rollout gating: Feature flags exist to enable deferred cards; default state is off. Canary release plan defined: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with rollback plan.
